verdict.rationale: Jan's docs say users can click Import Model and select GGUF files from local storage. Its local server is powered by llama.cpp, and the Hub can fetch Hugging Face models by ID, so loading and running GGUF models is clearly supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of GGUF loading, and documentation on choosing among GGUF quantization variants or tuning settings.
